answer: Make new accounts earn trust through a slow release rather than a lump sum. Each payout enters a river that drains into spendable balance over many epochs, and a fresh account sits on a narrow ledge where any failed audit drops its unreleased stream. A sybil operator splitting into a thousand wallets must keep every one honest for weeks before cashing out, so the farm's cost rises with time held. Viewed through that prism, patience becomes the price of each extra identity.
